6.122 rsMissingMIMEType
rsMissingMIMEType is a critical error that will occur when an element that requires a ReportMIMEType
value is not present within its parent element. For example, if an Image is missing its
Image.MIMEType child element and the value of the peer Image.Source element is set to "Database",
this error will occur.
